arxiv-2202-05970.title: Electrostatic control of quasiparticle poisoning in a hybrid semiconductor-superconductor island
arxiv-2202-05970.creator: H. Q. Nguyen, D. Sabonis, D. Razmadze, E. T. Mannila, V. F. Maisi, D. M. T. van Zanten, E. C. T. O’Farrell, P. Krogstrup, F. Kuemmeth, J. P. Pekola, C. M. Marcus
arxiv-2202-05970.description: Abstract The performance of superconducting devices is often degraded by the uncontrolled appearance and disappearance of quasiparticles, a process known as poisoning. We demonstrate electrostatic control of quasiparticle poisoning in the form of single-charge tunneling across a fixed barrier onto a Coulomb island in an InAs/Al hybrid nanowire.

arxiv-2302-03120.title: Studying Therapy Effects and Disease Outcomes in Silico using Artificial Counterfactual Tissue Samples
arxiv-2302-03120.creator: Martin Paulikat, Christian M. Schürch, Christian F. Baumgartner
arxiv-2302-03120.description: Abstract Understanding the interactions of different cell types inside the immune tumor microenvironment (iTME) is crucial for the development of immunotherapy treatments as well as for predicting their outcomes. Highly multiplexed tissue imaging (HMTI) technologies offer a tool which can capture cell properties of tissue samples by measuring expression of various proteins and storing them in separate image channels.

arxiv-2308-11392.title: Rest-Frame Near-Infrared Radial Light Profiles up to z = 3 z=3 from JWST/NIRCam: Wavelength Dependence of the Sérsic Index Journal: ApJ

arxiv-2401-17851.title: Instruction-Guided Scene Text Recognition
arxiv-2401-17851.creator: Yongkun Du, Zhineng Chen, Yuchen Su, Caiyan Jia, and Yu-Gang Jiang
arxiv-2401-17851.description: Abstract Multi-modal models have shown appealing performance in visual recognition tasks, as free-form text-guided training evokes the ability to understand fine-grained visual content. However, current models cannot be trivially applied to scene text recognition (STR) due to the compositional difference between natural and text images.

arxiv-2402-00258.title: Multi-group Learning for Hierarchical Groups
arxiv-2402-00258.creator: Samuel Deng, Daniel Hsu
arxiv-2402-00258.description: Abstract The multi-group learning model formalizes the learning scenario in which a single predictor must generalize well on multiple, possibly overlapping subgroups of interest. We extend the study of multi-group learning to the natural case where the groups are hierarchically structured.

arxiv-2409-16922.title: Decomposition of Equivariant Maps via Invariant Maps: Application to Universal Approximation under Symmetry
arxiv-2409-16922.creator: Akiyoshi Sannai sannai.akiyoshi.7z@kyoto-u.ac.jp, Yuuki Takai takai@neptune.kanazawa-it.ac.jp, Matthieu Cordonnier matthieu.cordonnier@gipsa-lab.fr
arxiv-2409-16922.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop a theory about the relationship between invariant and equivariant maps with regard to a group G G . We then leverage this theory in the context of deep neural networks with group symmetries in order to obtain novel insight into their mechanisms.

arxiv-2503-04401.title: Representations of Skew Left Braces of order p ​ q pq
arxiv-2503-04401.creator: Nishant Rathee, Ayush Udeep ∗
arxiv-2503-04401.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the irreducible representations of skew braces of order p ​ q pq , which is equivalent to studying the representation theory of groups of order p 2 ​ q 2 p^{2}q^{2} arising from skew left braces, where p > q p>q are primes.

arxiv-2506-19428.title: Learning quantum tomography from incomplete measurements
arxiv-2506-19428.creator: Mateusz Krawczyk, Pavel Baláž, Katarzyna Roszak, Jarosław Pawłowski
arxiv-2506-19428.description: Abstract We revisit quantum tomography in an informationally incomplete scenario and propose improved state reconstruction methods using deep neural networks. In the first approach, the trained network predicts an optimal linear or quadratic reconstructor with coefficients depending only on the collection of (already taken) measurement operators. This effectively refines the undercomplete tomographic reconstructor based on pseudoinverse operation.

arxiv-2512-08788.title: Commissioning of an experiment for thermodynamic and spectroscopic studies of hydrogen isotopologues at cryogenic conditions Journal: Fusion Engineering and Design
arxiv-2512-08788.creator: Joshua Kohpeiß, Dominic Batzler, Beate Bornschein, Lutz Bornschein, Robin Größle, Daniel Kurz, Ralph Lietzow, Alexander Marsteller, Michael Sturm, Stefan Welte
arxiv-2512-08788.description: Abstract To study thermodynamic properties and dynamic phase space behavior of hydrogen isotopologues (Q 2 ) at cryogenic temperatures and at high density, the Tritium Absorption InfraRed Spectroscopy 2 (T 2 ApIR) experiment has been set up and commissioned at Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe (TLK) .

arxiv-2512-21734.title: Knot Forcing: Taming Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models for Real-time Infinite Interactive Portrait Animation
arxiv-2512-21734.creator: Steven Xiao, Xindi Zhang, Dechao Meng, Qi Wang, Peng Zhang, Bang Zhang
arxiv-2512-21734.description: Abstract Real-time portrait animation is essential for interactive applications such as virtual assistants and live avatars, requiring high visual fidelity, temporal coherence, ultra-low latency, and responsive control from dynamic inputs like reference images and driving signals. While diffusion-based models achieve strong quality, their non-causal nature hinders streaming deployment.

pmc-11549990.creator: Zeyan Zhong, Dina Chen, Zhiyang Guan, Guoxing Zhong, Zhiyong Wu, Jianmin Chen, Jianhong Chen

pmc-12645875.title: Systematic mapping of small nucleolar RNA interactions in human cells
pmc-12645875.creator: Hywel Dunn-Davies, Tatiana Dudnakova, Jean-Louis Langhendries, Nicholas Watkins, Denis LJ Lafontaine, David Tollervey
pmc-12645875.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Altered expression of box C/D small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs) is implicated in human diseases, including cancer. Box C/D snoRNAs canonically direct site-specific, 2’-O-methylation but the extent to which they participate in other functions remains unclear. To identify RNA interactions of box C/D snoRNAs in human cells, we applied two techniques based on UV crosslinking, proximity ligation and sequencing of RNA hybrids (CLASH and FLASH). These identified hundreds of novel snoRNA interactions with rRNA, snoRNAs and mRNAs.

pmc-12707113.title: Translation and Psychometric Testing of the Fear of Falling Questionnaire-Revised in Community-Dwelling Older Adults
pmc-12707113.creator: Marina Arkkukangas, Karin Strömqvist Bååthe, Michail Tonkonogi, Emily S Bower, Ulf Larsson
pmc-12707113.description: PurposeFalls pose a significant health risk to older adults, often resulting in adverse outcomes. Despite the recognition of effective interventions, the psychological aspect of fear of falling (FoF) remains under-addressed. The Fear of Falling Questionnaire-Revised (FFQ-R) (15 and 6-item) was developed to assess FoF. However, no Swedish version is available, necessitating its translation and evaluation of psychometric testing.

pmc-12750548.title: Coordinated care program in the Polish primary healthcare: insights into the early implementation
pmc-12750548.creator: Mateusz Guziak, Anna Joanna Świtajska, Milena Šantrić-Milićević
pmc-12750548.description: BackgroundThe Coordinated Care Program (CCP) was introduced in Polish Primary Healthcare (PHC) in October 2022. It promised a significant transformation in the country’s PHC system by integrating extended diagnostics and chronic disease management to enhance patient access to PHC and improve healthcare outcomes.

pmc-13261410.title: Delivery of Monomethyl Auristatin E Using Ionizable Lipid Nanoparticles for B‑Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Treatment
pmc-13261410.creator: William H. Pentz, Krystal A. Hughes, Bishal Misra, Srikiran V. Nandigama, Aidan Murray, Aimery Samuelson, Morgan Surface, Rukiye Nur Akpolat-Seker, Boopalan Sivanathan, Sharan Bobbala
pmc-13261410.description: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are the leading method for clinically delivering nucleic acid cargoes such as messenger or small interfering RNAs. The capacity of LNPs to encapsulate and deliver small molecule therapeutics alongside traditional nucleic acid cargo remains largely unexplored. Beginning the development of a dual delivery approach using LNPs holds significant potential for treating malignancies prone to therapeutic resistance.

pmc-13268084.title: Outcomes of Unmonitored, Buried DIEP Flaps in Autologous Breast Reconstruction

pmc-13268084.description: ht to further investigate whether buried DIEP flaps without device monitoring were associated with similar complication rates to the traditional monitoring paddle. METHODS: A retrospective cohort review of 182 consecutive patients undergoing DIEP flap breast reconstruction performed at our institution between January 2018 to December 2024. Outcome measures were reoperation, readmission, operative time, follow-up time, reconstructive procedures, and complications.

pmc-13298407.title: IHOG: Interval-Optimized Hamming-Weight-Oriented Grouping for Enhanced Side-Channel Leakage Detection
pmc-13298407.creator: Jifang Jin, Tianqi Zhou, Ding Ding, Ye Huang, Bingqi Xie, Xiaoyi Duan
pmc-13298407.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The purpose of side-channel leakage detection is to determine whether or not there is side-channel leakage in the target cryptographic chip. The application of grouping (i.e., dividing the collected power traces into groups based on a property of the intermediate value, such as the Hamming weight of a byte or the bit value of an S-box output) in side-channel leakage detection is a research hotspot. The bit-level grouping mode and the byte-value grouping mode are proposed by previous scholars.

pmc-13491855.creator: Liye Dai, Yiting Sun, Jinfeng Yin, Yong Jiang, Hao Li, Yongjun Wang, Xia Meng
pmc-13491855.description: BackgroundThe high-sensitivity C-reactive protein-triglyceride glucose index (hsCTI) is an integrated biomarker reflecting systemic inflammation and insulin resistance. This study aimed to evaluate the association between hsCTI levels and the risk of stroke recurrence in a large, real-world cohort.MethodsWe analyzed data from the China National Stroke Registry-III, including patients with acute ischemic stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA).
